compatibility: Explicit opt-in for numerical API compatibility; required by the skill for any new Trex pivot/target qualification. Legacy profile is arithmetic only.

clauses.rule: Distinguish shape candidate, context-selected reference and covered pivot. Standard dominant-body candidates require incoming direction in this ordinary profile. Dominant-shadow reference colour is not a veto; its body cannot be counted as a third directional body if opposite. Gap/opposite-body cases require a separate model.

Use the last qualifying candidate within the supplied wave before the first strict cover. Flag a newer reference for reselection; never silently move the level or replace an existing reference with a virtual ATR line. Freeze a completed event at first cover; a later candidate belongs to a new review.

Three standard directional bodies and ATR displacement are alternative routes. Inspect every candle from declared start through master. Every counter bar or doji requires time-stamped no-pivot or settlement-bypassed context. Consecutiveness alone neither validates nor invalidates. A strict cover of an earlier geometric master contradicts a no-pivot assertion in this bounded profile.

A settlement annotation requires a later closed price strictly beyond that counter bar extreme in the incoming direction, within the preleg, and a review timestamp no earlier than that bypass. This conservative price proxy does not independently prove settlement identity.

The reproducible default displacement reference is three prior ATR; other supplied thresholds remain measured but require method review. A contextual 2.4 example does not justify a global 2.5 threshold. Baseline and endpoints must be explicit and causal.

Pinbar, long-shadow and self-cover are distinct descriptive branches. Self-cover needs opposite body and appropriately directed shadow; neither a matched silhouette nor two prior bodies plus the exception proves a third directional body. No blanket confirmation exemption is granted without a source-defined subtype and context.

Long-shadow screening uses that shadow length against prior ATR. Workbook pinbar screening keeps its existing definition. Self-cover screening uses body fraction 0.4 to 2/3, incoming-side shadow at least 1/3, opposite wick at most 0.1 and reversed body; this design band is a candidate filter only, not an executable exhaustive source rule or an order-node detector.

Separate level observation time from method qualification time. A later wave review blocks historical readiness but cannot erase a nearer known obstacle or restart its lifecycle. Preserve late covers as observations. No unresolved pivot or exception can qualify a target/continuation.

Trex remains primary, MACD/Fibonacci auxiliary. Report limits of supplied start, reference, noise labels and level inventory; technical checks and source interpretations do not validate profitability or the full method.
